title: Hero
desc: A barber encounters his ex-lover at a ruthless gang leader's hideout and attempts a daring escape, triggering a chaotic chase as goons pursue them relentlessly.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Baby John
desc: DCP Satya Verma fakes his death to shield his daughter from a deadly politician. But when enemies return, he must face his past to protect his family at all costs.

title: Bhaiaji Superhit
desc: Lal Bhaisahab Dubey, a feared Varanasi gangster, decides to star in a film and hires a writer-director team, hoping that his newfound stardom will win back his estranged wife.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: B.A.Pass 2
desc: A young woman escapes an arranged marriage and moves to Mumbai. Alone in the big city, she faces the tough world of showbiz and discovers the real meaning of life and love.

title: No Entry
desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Antim : The Final Truth
desc: A poor farmer's son rises in the city as a fearless gangster, but his reign is challenged when an unyielding cop steps in, sparking a fierce battle of power and justice.

title: Bulandi
desc: Dharamraj Thakur, a respected village leader, faces disgrace when his younger brother Arjun is falsely accused of raping a schoolteacher, shaking the village's trust and honor.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Baadshah
desc: A small time private detective gets embroiled in an industrialist's plot to assassinate a political leader.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Ghatak: Lethal
desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

title: Mission Raniganj : The Great Bharat Rescue
desc: Jaswant Singh Gill, a mining engineer, bravely leads a rescue mission to save 65 miners stuck inside a flooded coal mine, risking everything for their lives and safety.

title: Aparichit-The Stranger
desc: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personalities, turns vigilante at night. Guided by Garuda Purana, he hunts down criminals and exposes antisocial elements in society.
